text:
ada: PR #4760 updates /generate: 'verbosity' changed from numeric -> enum (Low|Medium|High) and made nullable. Top example still shows 1. Need example + SDK sweep. cc @ben

ben: Where are the snippets? I can patch Go/Rust quickly. Python and curl too?

claire: Runtime will accept numbers for now but coercion will be removed in next minor. Docs should show canonical enum strings, an omitted example, and a tiny migration note mapping 0->Low,1->Medium,2->High.

ada: Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4760. Affected files: apis/generate.md, sdk_snippets/*.{py,rs,go}, examples/curl.md.

ben: Plan: replace numeric examples with strings and add `// omit to use default (Medium)` example. Example curl I will add:

`curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rw-1","prompt":"hi","verbosity":"High"}'`

claire: Also add a short CHANGELOG blurb and a deprecation banner on the /generate page. Suggest text: "Numeric verbosity values are deprecated; map to strings (0->Low,1->Medium,2->High). Coercion will be removed in next minor."

docs-bot: Checklist added to PR: update examples (curl/py/rs/go), add CHANGELOG note, add deprecation banner, run docs build.

ben: I'll push the snippets patch in the next 20m and request review from @ada and @claire.

ada: Thanks — ping when ready and I'll merge after CI. :thumbsup:
